query: Analyse the current financial health and market sentiment of AAPL. Identify the top three risks to its share price over the next 90 days and suggest one data-driven hedge strategy.

financial_health.summary: Apple is trading at $340.42, just 1.42% below its 52‑week high of $345.34, with a strong bullish momentum label (score 0.71) and price above both the 50‑day SMA ($322.29) and 200‑day SMA ($290.07). Valuation remains premium with a forward P/E of 35.506 versus a trailing P/E of 39.039, while profit margin is 27.62% and ROE is an exceptional 148.75%. The balance sheet shows a debt‑to‑equity of 78.445% and a current ratio of 1.003, indicating balanced leverage but thin liquidity. Technical indicators show RSI at 61.23 (neutral‑to‑overbought) and MACD histogram negative, suggesting possible short‑term pullback. Overall, the stock combines high growth profitability with elevated volatility (annualised 26.36%).
financial_health.market_sentiment: The llm_sentiment analysis of ten recent headlines gave a modestly positive score of +0.1505 (Neutral), reflecting mixed but slightly upbeat coverage. Positive headlines such as “Apple gains share even as PC market slumps in Q3” and “Apple (AAPL) Has a New Catalyst That Could Drive Its Next Upgrade Cycle” support the bullish trend, while negative pieces like “Apple (AAPL) Stock Looks Fully Priced On Its 145% Five Year Run” and “Apple (AAPL) Stock Trades Above Fair Value On Cash Flow Estimates” highlight valuation concerns.

risks.name: Valuation compression
risks.description: High forward P/E of 35.5 and headlines suggesting the stock is fully priced could trigger a pull‑back if earnings guidance weakens.

evidence.detail: Forward P/E = 35.506 (high for a mature consumer‑tech giant)
Headline: "Apple (AAPL) Stock Looks Fully Priced On Its 145% Five Year Run" (negative sentiment)

risks.name: Technical overbought pullback
risks.description: RSI at 61.23 and price near the upper Bollinger band (BB %B 0.89) raise the risk of a short‑term correction.

evidence.detail: Headline: "Apple (AAPL) Stock Trades Above Fair Value On Cash Flow Estimates" (negative)

risks.name: Volatility‑driven downside
risks.description: The 60‑day annualised volatility of 26.36% implies a 90‑day 1‑sigma move of about 13.08%, matching the recent 1‑year max drawdown of –13.8%, exposing the share to sizable swings.

hedge.instrument: AAPL 90-day put, strike near the 1‑sigma low ($298.70)
hedge.rationale: Protects against the downside risk implied by the 13.08% 90‑day move and valuation‑compression scenario while allowing upside if price stays above the strike.
hedge.sizing: Buy 1 put contract (100 shares) with strike $298.70, covering ~12% of the current price
hedge.trade_offs: Cost of the put premium reduces net upside; if the stock rallies above $340 the hedge may expire worthless.
